Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest — Redwood + GitHub integration (self-serve signup)

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for Redwood last week to experiment with the hosted API — really impressed so far. We're evaluating how easily we could wire Redwood into our GitHub-driven CI for automated changelog generation and pre-merge pruning.

A couple quick questions before a demo: do you have a connector that listens to GitHub webhooks (org-level), and what permissions are required? Also curious about rate limits and whether the hosted plan is sufficient for an initial 150k tokens/month trial.

Would love to do a short call next week to walk through our repo layout and get a sense of integration effort. Our team is in PST.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Senior Platform Engineer
OpenForge Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@openforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest — Redwood + GitHub integration (self-serve signup)

Hi Alex — great to meet you, and thanks for signing up! 

Short answers up front: yes, we support org-level webhook flows and a GitHub App that can be scoped to repo/org permissions; the exact permissions depend on which events you need (pushes, PRs, issue comments). For 150k tokens/month the hosted plan is usually a fine starting point — we can talk about Dedicated if you need predictable throughput.

I'm Marissa on the SDR team; I can coordinate a 30-minute discovery with one of our integration AEs. Here are some slots (PST) we have next week: 
- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–10:30 
- Wed 2027-05-26 13:00–13:30 
- Thu 2027-05-27 08:30–09:00 

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min. 

Also, if you can share a short topology doc or a screenshot of your repo layout beforehand that'd help us prepare.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Solutions Development Representative
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex — Diego here, I'm the AE who works with GitHub/open-source accounts. Marissa looped me in. Thanks for the context — Friday should work. I pulled a couple alternative slots to cover both your window and ours (all PST):
- Fri 2027-05-28 11:00–11:30 (works for you)
- Fri 2027-05-28 12:30–13:00 (available on our side)
- Mon 2027-05-31 09:00–09:30 (backup)

Quick answers to your questions: we strongly recommend the GitHub App flow — it's installable at org or repo level and supports fine-grained event subscriptions so you can opt out of doc commits. We only request events you opt into and we provide example webhook filters in our integration guide. For token usage, we can show a projection on the call.

I've attached a short integration diagram and a link to a quick runbook that shows required permissions and an example webhook filter: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xIntegrationNotes (preview attached).

Attachment: redwood-integration-diagram.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

If 11:00 on Friday works, I'll send a calendar invite and include one of our Solutions Engineers (Ben) to walk through the webhook samples.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Developer Platform
Redwood Inference
